problem:
Which of the following completes the statement so that it is true:

*If the system $[\begin{aligned}a & b \\ c & d\end{aligned}]x=0$ has the unique zero solution, then $\text{__________}$ . *

- ${[\begin{aligned}a & b \\ c & d\end{aligned}]}^{-1}$ does not exist
- The lines $ax+by=0$ and $cx+dy=0$ intersect at infinitely many points
- $det[\begin{aligned}a & b \\ c & d\end{aligned}]\ne 0$
